admissionSummary.course: Visit 1 · Oct 15: 87-year-old post-op left hip ORIF with overnight confusion episode, declining hemoglobin, and hypokalemia. Plan discharge discussion with daughter; recheck CBC Friday..
admissionSummary.reason:
87-year-old woman with dementia, CKD stage 3, and osteoporosis admitted for post-acute rehab after left hip ORIF, now s/p left hip ORIF this admission with overnight confusion episode.
• Post-op left hip ORIF — hardware in good position on X-ray, pain managed with acetaminophen 650 mg q6h
• Anemia — hemoglobin 9.8 (down from 10.4), CBC recheck planned Friday
• Hypokalemia — potassium 3.4
• Confusion — one episode overnight around 2 am, redirected, no fall
• DVT prophylaxis — on enoxaparin 40 mg daily
• Discharge planning — discussion with daughter regarding home discharge date

value.preRoundNotes: Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. 87-year-old woman with dementia, CKD stage 3 and osteoporosis, here for rehab after left hip ORIF. Overnight one episode of confusion around 2 am, redirected, no fall. Vitals: BP 138/76, HR 82, temp 37.2, O2 95% on room air. Labs: hemoglobin 9.8 down from 10.4, potassium 3.4. Left hip X-ray shows the hardware in good position. On acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours and enoxaparin 40 mg daily. Plan: talk to her daughter about a discharge home date, recheck CBC on Friday.
